appearance_facts.fact: Bold black title reads 'Increasing Clean Grid Output from 2018 to 2023'. This is the only visible legend/title text.
Vertical y-axis label 'Grid Output (GWh)' is present and rotated 90 degrees.
A single solid blue line connects six data points across the plot area. The line starts high on the left, dips, rises to a peak, then declines slightly and flattens.
The first data point (2018) is located near the 2,800 GWh grid line.
The second data point (2019) is the lowest point on the line, located near the 2,400 GWh grid line.
The third data point (2020) is the highest point on the line, located slightly above the 2,800 GWh grid line.
The final three data points (2021, 2022, 2023) form a nearly flat segment, positioned between the 2,400 and 2,800 GWh grid lines, slightly lower than the 2020 peak.
